headlines.text: Looking back to 2022, when Sammy Guevara vs. Dustin Rhodes etched their names into history in the first-ever AEW Interim TNT Title match, appearing on Battle of the Belts, rated 6.23. With Cody sidelined by COVID protocol, his brother Dustin stepped in for a gutsy performance ? a real Canadian Destroyer through a table nearly stole the interim title before Guevara escaped with a last-second pinfall reversal.
Flash back to 2025, when Will Ospreay vs. Buddy Matthews met for the very first time, opening the card on Dynamite, rated 7.83 ? a match that delivered.
Flash back to 2020, when Chuck Taylor stepped back through the curtain after 6 weeks away, appearing on Dynamite.

secondaries.text: Back on this day in 2025, Powerhouse Hobbs vs. Adam Cole vs. Adam Page vs. Daniel Garcia vs. Jay White vs. Jeff Jarrett vs. Kyle O'Reilly vs. Lance Archer vs. Ricochet vs. Roderick Strong vs. Wheeler Yuta settled things in a Casino Gauntlet match on Dynamite, rated 6.72.
Turning the clock back to 2020: Isiah Kassidy made their return to AEW television after 7 weeks away, appearing on Dynamite.
It was 2022 when Ricky Starks vs. Matt Sydal went to battle over the FTW Title, appearing on Battle of the Belts, rated 5.94. Matt Sydal was challenging for gold for the very first time.
